title: When the Bell Falls
author: Casper Delacroix
blurb: Ansel Pemberton, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the harvest moon rises.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
